privacy_policy_intro: At Ahnoud, your privacy is deeply respected. We are committed to protecting your personal information and being transparent about how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you interact with our website and services.
privacy_section_1_intro: We may collect the following types of information:
privacy_section_1_item_1: Personal details such as your name, email address, phone number, and shipping address
privacy_section_1_item_2: Payment and transaction details (processed securely through trusted providers)
privacy_section_1_item_3: Browsing data including IP address, device type, and pages visited
privacy_section_1_item_4: Cookies and tracking technologies to improve your experience
privacy_section_2_item_2: Communicate with you about purchases, updates, or promotions
privacy_section_2_item_3: Improve our website, services, and customer experience
privacy_section_3_intro: We never sell your personal data. Your information may only be shared with:
privacy_section_3_item_2: Legal authorities when required by law
privacy_section_3_item_3: Service providers who help operate our platform
privacy_section_3_outro: All partners are required to protect your data with strict confidentiality.
privacy_section_4_text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data. While no system is 100% secure, we continuously upgrade our technologies to ensure your information remains safe.
privacy_section_5_text: Ahnoud uses cookies to personalize your experience, analyze traffic, and improve functionality. You may disable cookies through your browser settings at any time.
privacy_section_7_text: We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
